limitations: This tool finds *inconsistencies left by editing*. It cannot detect a screenshot that was rendered with fake content from the start (edited in a browser's DevTools, produced by a fake-receipt generator site, or generated by an AI image model).
'No evidence of editing' is not proof that a screenshot is genuine. Confirm important claims with the issuer (bank, payment app, sender).
Heavy re-compression or downscaling (e.g. after several re-shares) removes much of the evidence it relies on.
